texts.li: [victim] {X_nameDef} is back. The one who left {A_nameDef} bleeding in the dirt is marching at the head of a war party of {ENEMY}, and this time {X_nameDef} means to finish it.
[killed] {X_nameDef}, who killed {DEAD}, has come back with {ENEMY} behind {X_objective}. The colony remembers. So, it seems, does {X_nameDef}.
[maimed] {X_nameDef}, who maimed {DEAD}, is leading a war party of {ENEMY} against the colony. Whatever {X_nameDef} wants, it isn't peace.
[fled] {X_nameDef} is back, leading a war party of {ENEMY}. Last time {X_nameDef} got away. Nobody here intends to let that happen twice.
[hunts] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY}, who swore to hunt down {DEAD}, has found the colony again, and brought a war party to settle it.
[robbed] {X_nameDef} hasn't forgotten the money. {ENEMY} are marching on the colony with {X_nameDef} at their head, asking for {DEAD} by name.
[betrayed] {X_nameDef}, who turned a crew against {DEAD} and threw {DEAD} off the ship, is back to finish the job, with {ENEMY} behind {X_objective}.
[enslaved] {X_nameDef}, who once held {DEAD} in chains, is coming back with {ENEMY} to take back what {X_pronoun} still thinks is {X_possessive}.
{ENEMY} have not forgotten {DEAD}, who died in the colony's hands. A war party has come to settle the matter.
[lowtech] Blood calls for blood, the old saying goes. Kin of {DEAD}, who died a prisoner here, have come with {ENEMY} to answer the call.
[!lowtech] {ENEMY} are broadcasting one name, over and over, as they march on the colony: {DEAD}. They know {DEAD} died here, a prisoner. They've come to make someone pay for it.

[lowtech] A young soldier in the colours of {ENEMY} stumbles up to the colony with empty hands raised. {X_nameDef} has deserted, and {ENEMY} hang deserters. {X_nameDef} begs to be taken in. {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} first, and thinks the fear is real.

[!lowtech] A figure in {ENEMY} gear walks up to the colony with hands raised and weapon slung. {X_nameDef} has had enough of {ENEMY}, and they are not the forgiving kind. {X_nameDef} asks for shelter. {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} first, and believes the story.

{X_nameDef}, who fought for {ENEMY} until three days ago, is hiding in the scrub near the colony and has asked {A_nameDef} for help. Deserters don't live long among {ENEMY}. {X_nameDef} asks for shelter, and swears {X_pronoun} is done with fighting for anyone but friends.

li.label: Take {X_objective} in
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is one of us now. With any luck, {ENEMY} will never learn where {X_pronoun} went.
li.riskOutcome: {X_nameDef} is one of us now. {ENEMY} won't let it go, though: sooner or later they'll come looking.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their deserter
li.text: {ENEMY} have come for {X_nameDef}, who ran from them to us.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} goes back out into the wild, alone.

li.label: Hand {X_objective} back to {ENEMY}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is marched back to {ENEMY} under guard. {ENEMY} are pleased. {X_nameDef} is not.
